summary: D1 policy-engine revise-apply 091 resolves D1-RA-002 (P1, blocking): the Verification gate conflated fact availability with a passed result. Root cause: src/policy/preconditions.ts exposed only isVerificationFactAvailable() (availability boolean); both canRun and next treated true as sufficient — a future snapshot extension carrying a failed/not-run Verification field would wrongly allow review-apply and advance archive, violating fail-closed. Fix: new src/policy/verification-gate.ts introduces a status-aware VerificationGateResult (unavailable|passed|failed|not-run) shared by canRun and next via evaluateVerificationGate(snapshot); only passed releases the gate, each non-passed kind has a distinct blocked reason. blocked-diagnosis.ts gains verificationFailedDiagnosis()/verificationNotRunDiagnosis(); preconditions.ts drops isVerificationFactAvailable and gates review-apply (apply stage) + archive on evaluateVerificationGate; next.ts decideApplyStage (!lineage.match and approved branches) gates the same way. D1 behavior unchanged (gate always unavailable → verification-facts-unavailable); forward-compat branches are the single correct extension point. Per owner instruction, the explore artifact is also relocated from .tmp/explore/policy-engine/conclusion.md (gitignored, non-recoverable) to openspec/changes/policy-engine/explore.md, matching all 8 prior archived changes. proposal/design/spec/tasks unchanged; frozen specs / B1 states.ts / 069–090 terminal Runs unchanged. typecheck/build/lint/test(423)/openspec strict all pass. consistencyScan 7 dimensions, 0 contradictions. Next action: review-apply.

findingsAddressed.title: Verification gate conflates fact availability with a passed result
findingsAddressed.rootCause: preconditions.ts exposed only isVerificationFactAvailable() (availability), and both canRun (reviewSPreconditions apply stage, archivePreconditions) and next() (decideApplyStage !lineage.match + approved branches) treated true as sufficient. No predicate inspected the Verification result. Once a future change extends the snapshot with a Verification status field, failed/not-run values would be treated as a release — breaking the fail-closed contract and letting review-apply/archive advance on a non-passed result.
findingsAddressed.fix: New src/policy/verification-gate.ts: VerificationGateResult = unavailable|passed|failed|not-run; mapVerificationStatusToGate maps undefined→unavailable, passed→passed, failed→failed, not-run/not-applicable→not-run (fail-closed); readChangeVerificationStatus returns undefined in D1 (C1 has no field) — the single forward-compat point; evaluateVerificationGate(snapshot) is the shared entry for canRun and next; verificationGateUnmet(gate)→canRun unmet string; verificationGateDiagnosis(gate)→next blocked diagnosis. blocked-diagnosis.ts adds verificationFailedDiagnosis()/verificationNotRunDiagnosis(). preconditions.ts removes isVerificationFactAvailable; reviewSPreconditions (apply stage) and archivePreconditions use evaluateVerificationGate + verificationGateUnmet. next.ts decideApplyStage (!lineage.match and approved branches) uses evaluateVerificationGate + verificationGateDiagnosis. D1 behavior unchanged: gate is always unavailable → verification-facts-unavailable (canRun rejects, next blocks). Only passed releases the gate.
findingsAddressed.verificationEvidence: verification-gate.ts: VerificationGateResult discriminated union + mapVerificationStatusToGate + evaluateVerificationGate. preconditions.ts: reviewSPreconditions apply-stage branch + archivePreconditions gate on evaluateVerificationGate. next.ts: decideApplyStage !lineage.match and approved branches gate via evaluateVerificationGate + verificationGateDiagnosis. blocked-diagnosis.ts: verificationFailedDiagnosis/verificationNotRunDiagnosis with distinct reasons. verification-gate.test.ts: covers mapping, unmet, diagnosis for all 4 kinds; failed → verification-failed (not verification-facts-unavailable). 423/423 tests pass. In D1 the gate is always unavailable → next() and canRun(review-apply)/canRun(archive) all return verification-facts-unavailable, identical surface behavior to 090 but now forward-correct.
